description:
Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 commits 48b6a31 (DID URIs acknowledged) and 5bfb16d (federated/DID-URI textual forms for user mentions).

Current state: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/contact.rs ChatContact.id has type `Id` (opaque newtype around String). The wire is already correct — any opaque URI form will round-trip. But there is no doc-comment confirming this latitude.

## Acceptance

- ChatContact.id rustdoc adds a note: "Spec acknowledges this as any opaque URI form, including but not limited to user@host (federated), DID URIs per W3C DID-Core (did:web:..., did:key:...), and other future forms. Servers and clients MUST treat the value as opaque; do not parse, validate, or normalize."
- Mention.id rustdoc (jmap-chat-types/src/message.rs) carries the same note: "The mentioned ChatContact.id; any opaque URI form. The textual representation in the message body (e.g. @user@host, @did:web:..., or @display-name) is composer-defined and is NOT recoverable from this field alone."
- One round-trip test in chat-types/src/contact.rs ensures a ChatContact with id = "did:web:alice.example" serializes and deserializes cleanly (and the wire JSON has the verbatim string)

## Out of scope

- Any validation of URI form (the point is there is none)
- Composer-side textual-form parsing (consumer's job)
title: Layer A: Doc-comment confirmation on ChatContact.id URI-form latitude (DID, federated, etc.)
